ui.noImpact: Task rows and cards replace the visible Personal or Shared word with a person or group icon while retaining the workspace name and the existing localized tooltip and screen-reader context. Task behavior, permissions, settings and documented workflows are unchanged.

release.noImpact: The Compose release archive now includes postgres-healthcheck.sh, which the bundled database already bind-mounts, and packaging refuses archives missing any bind-mounted script. Release steps, assets and documented procedures are unchanged.

configuration.note: Document container-readable file secrets, atomic role initialization, missing-role health failures and safe recovery without widening application privileges.

deployment.note: Document container-readable file secrets, atomic role initialization, missing-role health failures and safe recovery without widening application privileges.

native.note: Document native export source labels and upload times, separate system save dialogs, retained prepared files after cancellation or save failure, and Saved only after a confirmed write.
